prompt: Subject: Arms gathering light Main: A vertical 3:4 realistic fashion portrait. A woman sits on a light beige sofa with one knee up, slightly right of center, captured from the upper body to the thighs. The subject occupies about 75% of the frame, with window and wall space on the left and a chest with framed art in the background right. Person/Expression: A natural, realistic adult woman. Slender model-like physique with mature curves. dark brown long hair in a messy high ponytail with thin strands around the face. Elegant coral makeup, delicate eyelashes, natural skin texture, and subtle glossy lips. Profile view facing right, looking into the distance, with a quiet and dignified expression. Clothing/Pose: ivory thin-strap mini slip dress. Deep V-neckline with intersecting straps, soft matte satin fabric. Right arm bent overhead with the hand behind the head. Left arm naturally down, shoulders slightly back. Hips shifted left, right leg forward, left leg bent back on the sofa. Drawcord at the left waist creates soft folds across the thigh. Background/Light: Quiet interior in ivory and warm gray. Large window on the left with thin curtains, wooden chest and pottery on the right. Warm natural light from the lower left highlights the face, neck, and shoulders. Soft shadows on the right with gentle reflected light. Composition/Camera: Vertical, eye-level view. 85mm lens equivalent, close distance. Sharp focus on face and chest, blurred background. Style: High-end fashion magazine interior portrait. Natural skin, fine hair, satin sheen. Warm film tones, fine grain, soft highlights. Negative: Underage-looking persons, unnatural faces/eyes, extra fingers, joint issues, physical impossibilities, bad perspective, logos, watermarks.

promptZh: 主体：Arms gathering light 主要内容：一张 3:4 比例的竖构图写实时尚人像。一位女性坐在浅米色沙发上，单膝抬起，位于画面中心偏右位置，取景范围从上半身到大腿。主体占据约 75% 的画面，左侧为窗户和墙面空间，右侧背景为带有装饰画的斗柜。人物/表情：一位自然、写实的成年女性。纤细的模特身材，成熟且富有曲线感。dark brown 长发梳成凌乱的高马尾，脸颊两侧留有细碎发丝。优雅的珊瑚色妆容，精致的睫毛，自然的皮肤质感，以及淡淡的亮泽唇妆。侧脸朝向右侧，望向远方，表情安静而端庄。服装/姿势：ivory 细肩带迷你吊带裙。深 V 领设计，交叉肩带，柔软的哑光缎面材质。右手弯曲举过头顶，手放在脑后。左手自然下垂，双肩微向后展。臀部向左偏移，右腿向前，左腿向后弯曲在沙发上。左腰部的抽绳设计在大腿处形成柔和的褶皱。背景/光影：安静的象牙色与暖灰色调室内环境。左侧有带薄纱窗帘的大窗户，右侧摆放着木质斗柜和陶器。来自左下方的温暖自然光照亮了面部、颈部和肩部。右侧阴影柔和，带有细腻的反射光。构图/相机：竖构图，平视视角。85mm 等效镜头，近距离拍摄。面部和胸部焦点清晰，背景虚化。风格：高端时尚杂志室内人像。自然的皮肤质感，细腻的发丝，缎面光泽。温暖的胶片色调，细腻的颗粒感，柔和的高光。负面提示词：未成年人外观、不自然的面部/眼睛、多余的手指、关节问题、物理结构错误、透视错误、Logo、水印。
